purpose: Record evidence found during southwest/Tobago gap QA and explain why two tempting routes were not promoted automatically.

confirmedInDataset.basis: Existing official-current PTSC directional route in services data.
Existing Route 5 maxi directional service in services data, supported by earlier route/fare sources.
Existing Tobago PTSC/taxi directional service in services data.

leftUnresolved.reason: The current graph has Point Fortin to La Brea and La Brea to San Fernando, but routing La Brea to San Fernando and back west to Point Fortin is a destination-bypass/backtracking pattern. Do not loosen the router or invent reverse PTSC service without stronger evidence.
evidenceNeeded: Official/current La Brea to Point Fortin service listing
Association or field confirmation that La Brea is a two-way intermediate pickup/drop-off on the San Fernando to Point Fortin Route 5 corridor

researchSignals.name: PTSC routes and schedules index includes Point Fortin/La Brea references
researchSignals.use: directional signal only; not enough by itself to create a reverse pattern

researchSignals.name: Newsday reporting on Point Fortin/San Fernando/La Brea fare and waiting patterns
researchSignals.use: supports the corridor existing, but needs a current route-specific confirmation before promotion

leftUnresolved.reason: The current graph confirms Scarborough to Crown Point, but does not yet have enough modeled evidence for Crown Point back to Scarborough ferry terminal, including either reverse public service and/or a safe terminal connection to the ferry node.
evidenceNeeded: Official/current Crown Point to Scarborough PTSC direction or reliable route-taxi confirmation
Mapped safe walk/local transfer between Scarborough PTSC/taxi hub and Scarborough ferry terminal

researchSignals.name: PTSC schedules index lists Scarborough Tobago depot
Public travel sources mention PTSC Scarborough/Crown Point service
researchSignals.use: directional/useful context, not enough to silently infer app routing

qaRule: If a journey would require backtracking away from the destination or assuming a reverse direction/ferry-terminal transfer, the app should prefer no route until the missing connector is explicitly modeled.
